reason: New Year is coming and I need a gift for the family table. Something Georgian about the tamada and toasts is exactly the kind of thing that reminds me of home, and 45 lari is fine for a present.
objection: 60 word cards and 24 themes. After two or three supras everyone will know all the words, and then it sits on the shelf. And at our table the same uncle gives every toast anyway; will the others even play?
would_change_my_mind: If I saw that the words run out after a couple of evenings, or that there are no expansion packs, I would not buy it a second time or as a gift for anyone else.
